task_1.title: Fix regression where conftest.py files outside source tree are not picked up
task_1.description: Pytest 7.1.0 introduced a regression in the confcutdir filtering logic within PytestPluginManager that caused conftest.py files located outside the source tree (e.g. in site-packages or other external directories) to be silently ignored during test collection. The root cause was an overly restrictive path-matching check that only recognized conftest files that were direct descendants of the confcutdir, rather than correctly excluding only ancestor directories. This broke projects that relied on conftest.py files installed as part of third-party packages or placed in non-standard locations outside the project root.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement:
Ensure that conftest.py files located outside the project source tree (e.g. in site-packages or other external directories) are correctly discovered and loaded during test collection, reversing a regression introduced in 7.1.0. Specifically:
- Ensure conftest.py files in third-party package directories (such as site-packages) are picked up when they were previously working in versions prior to 7.1.0.
- Ensure conftest.py files that are descendants of the confcutdir continue to be loaded.
- Ensure conftest.py files in directories that are ancestors of the confcutdir continue to be excluded.
- Ensure custom markers, fixtures, and hooks defined in external conftest.py files are properly registered and available during test runs.

expectation.grounded: The PytestPluginManager confcutdir filtering method should return True (allow loading) for conftest.py paths that are not ancestor directories of _confcutdir, and return False (exclude) only for paths that are ancestors of _confcutdir. When _confcutdir is None, all conftest.py files should be considered. This restores the pre-7.1.0 behavior where conftest.py files in directories like site-packages were correctly discovered. Marks registered in external conftest.py files (e.g. via pytest.mark) should no longer produce PytestUnknownMarkWarning after the fix.
expectation.conceptual: Conftest.py files should be discovered based on whether they sit above the confcutdir boundary in the directory hierarchy. Files in unrelated directory trees (such as installed packages) should be loaded normally, as they are neither within nor above the project's confcutdir. Only conftest.py files in ancestor directories of the confcutdir should be excluded from loading.

constraints.grounded: The fix must not cause conftest.py files in ancestor directories of _confcutdir to be loaded, preserving the confcutdir boundary semantics. The fix must not alter behavior when _confcutdir is None (all conftest files should still be loaded). The PytestPluginManager plugin discovery interface must remain unchanged. No new public API is introduced.
constraints.conceptual: The confcutdir filtering boundary must continue to prevent conftest.py files above the project root from interfering with test collection. The fix must be a pure behavioral correction that restores pre-regression behavior without introducing new configuration options or changing the confcutdir contract.

behavior: When _confcutdir is set and a conftest.py resides in a directory that is NOT an ancestor of _confcutdir (e.g. site-packages, sibling directories, or unrelated paths), the conftest is loaded.
When _confcutdir is set and a conftest.py resides in an ancestor directory of _confcutdir, the conftest is excluded.
When _confcutdir is set and a conftest.py resides within or at the _confcutdir itself, the conftest is loaded.
When _confcutdir is None, all conftest.py files are loaded regardless of location.
Fixtures, markers, and hooks defined in external conftest.py files (e.g. in site-packages) are properly registered and available during test execution.
Previously working test suites that relied on external conftest.py files (e.g. SciPy with conftest in site-packages) no longer emit unknown mark warnings or fail to pick up configuration.
acceptance_criteria: When a conftest.py exists in a site-packages directory and confcutdir is set to the project root, the conftest.py should be discovered and loaded during test collection.
When a conftest.py exists in a parent directory above the confcutdir, it should NOT be loaded.
When a conftest.py exists within the confcutdir or its subdirectories, it should be loaded.
When confcutdir is None, all conftest.py files should be loaded regardless of their location.

Given a third-party package that installs a conftest.py in site-packages with custom markers, when running pytest with that package installed, then the custom markers should be recognized without PytestUnknownMarkWarning.

Given a project that previously worked under pytest 7.0.x with external conftest.py files, when upgrading to the fixed version, then all previously discovered conftest.py files should be discovered again.
